adapter_requirements: Join official metadata to recover speakers and chronological dialogue order.
Release insertion order consists of seven label blocks; it must not become dialogue context or mask order.
Fixed mean pooling gives text 300, audio 32, video 2048 dimensions; no learned projection is required.
Missing original utterances must not be silently dropped or fabricated when keeping the existing missing-mask protocol unchanged.
limits: Training pickle is incomplete and cannot yet be unpickled/audited.
Exact feature extraction checkpoint, vocabulary construction splits, and feature preprocessing are not released in the official code.
Official paper says ResNet-101 and wav2vec 2.0; actual released audio dimension is 32, so do not claim 768-dimensional hidden features.
No model was trained and no project code was modified.
